phases.name: The Lantern Burns Bright
phases.say: (He opens his eyes for the first time.)

say.open: (A monk hangs in the air above the ice, a lantern in his hand. He does not look up.)
say.death: (The lantern goes out, and he settles to the ice as if to sleep.)

bestiary.lore: The card of solitude and seeking: a monk who climbed above the Deep Cold to be alone, and does not want company.
bestiary.weakness: Earth brings him down. Strike while he is not hidden.
bestiary.pattern: Every fourth turn he withdraws (hidden, healing); stillness slows and Stops a row; his lantern blinds the Back. At half he withdraws every third turn and his light finds the weakest.
